atoms.text: The amount of food that is produced through organic farming is still very low in the United Kingdom. The idea of organic farming is to work together with nature to produce healthy food. Organic farmers want to return to the way farming was before industrial times and try to copy the way that plants naturally grow. That means they avoid planting only one kind of crop in the same area. They also try to exclusively use organic chemicals to protect crops from insects and diseases, instead of using harsher artificial chemicals.

They do this, for example, by planting many kinds of vegetables in the same patch and only using natural fertilisers. This helps nature to stay in balance. The soil stays healthy, the water does not become polluted and the air remains clean. However, the biggest disadvantages of organic farming are that it is more labour-intensive and, for now, often can’t produce as much food as conventional farming.
